proposed.explanation: The portfolio has a total market value of 59,795.00 EGP, consisting of 15,000.00 EGP in cash (25.1%), 1,500 shares of EFID valued at 30,600.00 EGP (51.2%), and 100 shares of ETEL valued at 14,195.00 EGP (23.7%). The investor's 1-year 10% liquidity requirement equates to 5,979.50 EGP, which is fully satisfied by the current 15,000.00 EGP cash balance. EFID reported a consolidated net profit of 2,695,301,670 EGP for FY2025 on consolidated revenue of 20,915,072,432 EGP and total equity of 5,724,525,864 EGP, translating to earnings per share of 2.18 EGP. At a current price of 20.40 EGP per share, EFID trades at a reasonable price-to-earnings ratio of approximately 9.36 and delivers a high return on equity of ~47.08%. For context, ETEL reported a net profit of 22,578,063,000 EGP on operating revenues of 106,672,946,000 EGP and total equity of 63,687,826,000 EGP, with earnings per share of 11.93 EGP. Holding EFID maintains strong equity exposure for 3-5 year steady growth while protecting liquidity and buffering against low financial capacity for losses.
